description: This file defines the ClientObserverPlacementStrategyResolver class which implements the IPlacementStrategyResolver interface. It provides logic to resolve placement strategy for client observer grains based on their type.

classes.name: ClientObserverPlacementStrategyResolver
classes.description: A resolver class determining if a grain type should use the ClientObservers placement strategy based on the grain’s properties.

methods.name: TryResolvePlacementStrategy
methods.description: Attempts to resolve and assign the appropriate placement strategy for a given grain type, returning true if successful.
